Mod.Name: 对话框下移 / Lower Dialogue Box
Mod.Author: 远风肆业
Mod.Description:
下移普通顾客、持枪瞄准及治安官检查时的对话框和姓名框，减少遮挡脸部。仅调整 UI 位置，可独立使用，启用或更新后重启游戏。
检测到指定的未经授权工坊条目时，主菜单会显示红色提醒和六步 Steam 账号自救流程。
Moves dialogue and name boxes lower for regular customers, weapon aiming, and security inspections. When the specified Workshop item is detected, the main menu displays a red warning with six steps to secure your Steam account. Restart the game after enabling or updating.
